summary: Created integration tests for HomeScreen using AndroidJUnit4 framework to verify app launch, loading states, video rendering, like button functionality, vertical paging, and action items
tests: All 8 tests passed (7 HomeScreenTest + 1 ExampleInstrumentedTest). Created integration tests: (1) testAppLaunchesSuccessfully verifies state and video rendering, (2) testLoadingStateDisplaysProgressIndicator verifies loading state, (3) testVideoContentIsDisplayed verifies author/description/music data, (4) testLikeButtonIsClickable verifies like button callback triggering, (5) testLikeCountIncrementsAfterLike verifies state update logic after like, (6) testVerticalPagingHandlesMultipleVideos verifies multiple video support, (7) testAllActionItemsAreVisible verifies action item counts. Tests use @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class) and focus on state/callback integration points.
